body_markdown:
"Our daughter, Lillie Mae, spent time in the NICU after she was born. Like so many NICU parents, bringing her home was something we dreamed about every day—but when that day finally came, it also brought a whole new level of worry.


After spending days surrounded by monitors, nurses, and constant reassurance, suddenly being responsible for every breath and every movement felt overwhelming. I found myself checking on her constantly, especially while she slept. Every little noise, pause, or movement would send my anxiety spiraling.


That’s where our[Owlet Dream Sock](https://owletcare.com/products/owlet-dream-sock?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blog_post&utm_campaign=OwletStory) became such an important part of our journey.


Our Dream Sock gave us the confidence to transition from the NICU to home life. Being able to monitor Lillie Mae’s oxygen levels and pulse rate provided an incredible sense of reassurance during that time. Instead of spending every moment wondering if she was okay, I could rest knowing I had an extra layer of awareness while she slept.


As a first-time mom, the peace of mind Owlet provided was priceless. It didn’t replace safe sleep practices or our pediatrician’s guidance, but it helped ease the anxiety that so many NICU parents carry home with them. It allowed me to spend less time worrying and more time enjoying those precious newborn moments.


Today, when I rock Lillie Mae to sleep and watch her rest peacefully, I’m grateful for the confidence our Dream Sock gave our family during one of the most emotional transitions of our lives. Bringing a NICU baby home can be scary, but having that extra reassurance helped us focus on what mattered most—loving our little girl and soaking up every moment together.


Owlet didn’t just help us monitor our daughter; it helped us find peace, confidence, and rest during a season when we needed it most." - Kate L.


Share your Owlet story[here](https://owletcare.com/pages/share-your-story?utm_source=blog&utm_medium=blogpost&utm_campaign=OwletStory) .


**As a reminder, Dream Sock® is intended to track your baby's pulse rate and oxygen level and keep parents informed, but it is not intended to diagnose, treat or cure any disease or other condition including, but not limited to, Sudden Infant Death Syndrome (SIDS) and/or Respiratory Syncytial Virus (RSV). This story reflects one family's experience. Individual experiences may vary.*
